--- pipe_join_hint.sql
FROM LeftTable
|> JOIN@{JOIN_TYPE=HASH_JOIN} RightTable USING(id)

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 14,
            Name:    "LeftTable",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeJoin{
        Pipe: 15,
        Op:   "INNER JOIN",
        Hint: &ast.Hint{
          Atmark:  22,
          Rbrace:  43,
          Records: []*ast.HintRecord{
            &ast.HintRecord{
              Key: &ast.Path{
                Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                  &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 24,
                    NameEnd: 33,
                    Name:    "JOIN_TYPE",
                  },
                },
              },
              Value: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 34,
                NameEnd: 43,
                Name:    "HASH_JOIN",
              },
            },
          },
        },
        Right: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 45,
            NameEnd: 55,
            Name:    "RightTable",
          },
        },
        Cond: &ast.Using{
          Using:  56,
          Rparen: 64,
          Idents: []*ast.Ident{
            &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 62,
              NameEnd: 64,
              Name:    "id",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM LeftTable |> INNER JOIN @{JOIN_TYPE=HASH_JOIN} RightTable USING (id)
